paper_title: Searching for scalar field dark matter with LIGO
suggested_experiment_name: LIGO O3 Scalar Field Dark Matter Search
coupling_convention: Λ_e^{-1} in GeV^{-1}, as plotted on y-axis. This represents the inverse of the coupling scale for scalar field dark matter coupling to the electromagnetic field tensor and electron rest mass.
notes: Paper presents new upper limits on scalar field dark matter coupling constants Λ_e^{-1} and Λ_γ^{-1} from LIGO O3 data in the frequency band 10–180 Hz (mass range ~5×10^{-14} to ~1×10^{-12} eV). However, the actual numerical limit values cannot be extracted from the provided text. Figure 3 shows the exclusion limits as plots but no explicit numerical data table or precise coupling values are given in the paper excerpt. The coupling type is ambiguous: the paper constrains both (1) Λ_e (coupling to electron mass, suggesting ScalarElectron) and (2) Λ_γ (coupling to fine-structure constant, suggesting ScalarPhoton). The pre-analysis hint suggests ScalarBaryon, but the paper's Lagrangian (Eq. 2) explicitly couples to the electron mass and electromagnetic field tensor, not to baryon mass or nucleon fields. The most accurate interpretation is that this paper constrains scalar couplings to the Standard Model via electron mass and photon field modifications, which would map to ScalarElectron and ScalarPhoton respectively—not ScalarBaryon. Given the ambiguity and lack of extractable numerical data, confidence is very low.
